expectations.text: References Gap A4 from the gap registry as context
expectations.evidence: Executive Summary opens with 'Sentry is a CRITICAL hard gate before your first beta user' and tags as 'Severity: CRITICAL (Gap A4)'.
Step 2A: 'npm install @sentry/nextjs' and 'npx @sentry/wizard@latest -i nextjs' with explanation of what each command does.

expectations.text: Includes config code with DSN, release tagging, and sample rates
expectations.evidence: Full sentry.client.config.ts and sentry.server.config.ts with DSN, VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA release, sampleRate 1.0, tracesSampleRate 0.2, replays config.

expectations.text: Configures alert rules appropriate for AKBai (payment errors, auth spikes)
expectations.evidence: Part 5 defines 5 alert rules: Payment Errors (P0), Auth Failures Spike (P1), High Error Rate (P1), New Unhandled Exception (P2), API Performance Degradation (P2).

expectations.text: Mentions Slack integration for alert routing
expectations.evidence: Part 1C covers Slack integration setup. Part 5B configures #akbai-alerts channel with mobile push notifications.

expectations.text: Notes free tier limits (5K events/mo) and cost implications
expectations.evidence: Cost Summary table shows free tier limits (5K errors/mo, 50 replays, 1 team member) with $26/mo upgrade path. Phase 1 projection of ~500 errors/month.
